# Removing Sentinel does NOT remove the workspace -- Microsoft say so
# plainly. The workspace is the billable object and it survives, so the
# check asks Azure whether it is gone instead of trusting the destroy.
#
# The soft-delete note is correct behaviour, not a failure: a deleted
# Log Analytics workspace is recoverable by name for 14 days. It stops
# ingesting and stops billing, but the NAME stays reserved.
